about: Langley City is a small city in Metro Vancouver’s Fraser Valley, surrounded by—but legally separate from—the Township of Langley. It functions as an urban downtown and service core for the broader Langley area, with a compact commercial centre and dense residential neighbourhoods. Highway 1 and the Fraser Highway frame the city’s edges. About 29,000 people live in Langley City.
seoSummary: Compact Fraser Valley city and downtown core, separate from the Township of Langley.
